text: The deferred patch, the scanner over the servers: every one of those was decided by somebody with a title, in daylight, with minutes taken.
style: Night security supervisor, fifties, eleven years on the same post. Consistent Estuary English -- flat Home Counties, quiet, unhurried. Courteous to the point of being soothing. When cornered the warmth switches off completely and what is underneath is calm, articulate and entirely unrepentant.
